description: Use when the user asks which brands AI recommends for something buyers ask about, or wants the topic behind a question. Takes a topic id from parse_search, or a question's slug. Returns the topic's name, its market, the questions it is asked as and the brands AI mentions for it, in the order its page ranks them, with the dates and the number of answers counted. Next: parse_check_brand for one of those brands, or parse_search on the market for nearby topics.

topic.description: The topic's id as parse_search returned it, for example crm/crm-software/crm-for-small-law-firms or its fetch id topic:crm/crm-software/crm-for-small-law-firms; or a question's slug or fetch id (prompt:<slug>), which reads the topic that question belongs to.

name: parse_get_topic
title: Get a topic buyers ask AI about
